stalls.where: 實踐路88號（實踐路與大仁四街口）
stalls.summaryZh: 幾乎每篇中原夜市清單都會提到；皮薄湯多、現包現蒸，排隊常見但出餐快。建議現場趁熱吃，外帶皮容易變硬，也有人覺得評價兩極。
stalls.summaryEn: Named in nearly every Zhongyuan list: thin-skinned, juicy dumplings steamed to order. Lines are common but move fast; eat on the spot, as skins toughen when taken away. Some find it overrated.

stalls.where: 中山東路二段170之2號（由攤車改為店面）
stalls.summaryZh: 手工客家麻糬，軟Q有甜有鹹，配料可選花生粉、玉米脆片、煉乳或自製肉鬆。一週只營業約四天，常大排長龍，建議趁溫熱吃。
stalls.summaryEn: Handmade Hakka mochi, soft and chewy, in sweet or savory versions with peanut powder, corn flakes, condensed milk or house pork floss. Open only about four days a week and often queued; best eaten warm.

stalls.summaryZh: 超大車輪餅包進鹹酥雞與牽絲起司，一個就很有飽足感，是學生口中的創意必買；週二公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Oversized wheel cakes stuffed with popcorn chicken and stretchy cheese; one is nearly a meal. A creative favorite with students; closed Tuesdays.

stalls.summaryZh: 餅皮Q脆、包著半熟流心蛋，可再加雞排或起司；網友提醒辣醬很辣，油品每日更換、吃起來不膩。
stalls.summaryEn: Chewy-crisp pancake wrapped around a runny half-cooked egg, with optional cutlet or cheese add-ons. Reviewers warn the chili sauce is fiery; oil is changed daily so it isn't greasy.

stalls.summaryEn: Big buns pan-fried on one side with a crisp base and peppery scallion filling, often likened to pepper buns; some say the crust outshines the filling.

stalls.summaryEn: A low-key veteran stall rolling and frying pancakes on a big griddle: thick, crisp and fragrant, and cheap enough to be a student staple.

stalls.summaryEn: Torched on the spot for a crackly top over silky custard; many buy several at once. Opens in the evening and closes when sold out.
